title: Idle Loop Control Action
statement: For finite Boolean Turing machines $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$, any input-head movement $\mathrm{inp}$, and any optional next loop-host state, the loop-control action that makes no writes or movements on its work tapes and emits no output is the control action that makes the same input-head movement and passes to that next state.
